notes.title: Version 1.3.2.1 (some hotfixes)
notes.content:
Hello Willowguards! 

Thank you so much to everyone who made it to Gamescom to play our game, give us feedback, and everything else. It was wonderful to see you, and to watch you play. And, of course, as is tradition, you managed to find some new things that were a bit bork'd. So here's a quick patch fixing some of the more glaring issues we found...please enjoy.

[list] 
[*] Fix to Rage removing your primary attack after finishing.
[*] Prevented Q and E to be pressed at the same time in ability unlock popup, which sometimes caused an extra "Are you sure you want to override..." prompt to be displayed.
[*] Card craft popup now correctly says "Card Crafted" not "Card Upgraded"
[*] Loot window scroll bar can now be dragged with mouse
[*] When equipment is upgraded, it now shows a full tooltip with all the info, instead of just stats and icon.
[*] Upgraded cards shown during popup are scaled properly now
[*] Ability override prompt should now show the button prompt for Yes / No properly
[*] You can now get into the dungeon pause menu even after finishing a dungeon by clicking Esc instead of holding it down (after the 'Hold down Esc to exit dungeon' prompt appears)
[*] Fix to the Back button not being useable in the Show Clues/Items menu on the Steam Deck (or actually at specific resolutions)
[*] Camp training level now has an objective showing again.
[*] Fixed extremely rare and difficult to achieve soft lock to do with the Willow Grove - you can now look at the wound using the regular Observe function.
[/list]

notes.title: The Juice Update: Version 1.3
notes.content: [p]Hello Willowguards![/p][p][/p][p]This update has been brewing for quite a while, encompassing all of those little notes we had left over from the launch marked "add more juice". We also added some new content, especially around the Lumberyard, and under the hood we've been working steadily towards a proper Dungeon Run mode (if you're coming to Gamescom in Cologne, we'll be showcasing it there!).[/p][p][/p][p]Without further ado, here're some changelog highlights:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added an input buffer for snappier controls and better feel when fighting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added stagger animations to all enemies whenever you hit them.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new screen flash effects when getting hit/healed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added screen shake for explosions/hard hits (can be disabled in options)[/p][/*][*][p]Active abilities can now be recharged, and will stay in your ability wheel even when at 0 charges. Recharging happens through special cards (currently - more ways to recharge coming up!)[/p][/*][*][p]You can now draw more than 2 cards at once (by default, your Max Draw is upgraded through Action Surges - Tenacity will start you with a 3rd card from the first upgrade, the others only from the second upgrade on). In the future, look out for cards and equipment that may further increase your Max Draw![/p][/*][*][p]Some new cards, including a smaller bomb, "Grenade", for all your explodey needs.[/p][/*][*][p]An all-new character, Nela, with an all-new quest chain centered around the Lumberyard, featuring new locations, new monsters, and new mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]A new objective system, allowing for more dynamic objectives (currently in use mainly for the new in-progress Dungeon Run systems).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to aspect ratio, making the Steam Deck no longer get cut off.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes, balancing, changes to cards, fixes to maps, etc.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We think the game feels much better to play now, but of course there may still be kinks to iron out - so please let us know of any bugs or issues you find, either in the Steam Forums or better yet, in our Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Also:[/p][p][b]WE WILL BE AT GAMESCOM![/b] All weekend, 20-24th of August, in Cologne, Germany! If you want to come test out some Dungeon Running, meet the developers, or grab some exclusive Willow Guard swag, please, please stop by![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531781/3014249167400e35bbf67e41d7b89c9a10a85b02.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the new patch & our Gamescom presence, we will also be participating in the Gamescom Steam event, starting on August 19! Be sure to pick the game up then, if not before.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, the Demo version will of course also be updated, as always, and the saves from the demo will - as always - be compatible with the full game![/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Added an input buffer for snappier controls and better feel when fighting.
Added stagger animations to all enemies whenever you hit them.
Added new screen flash effects when getting hit/healed.
Added screen shake for explosions/hard hits (can be disabled in options)
Active abilities can now be recharged, and will stay in your ability wheel even when at 0 charges. Recharging happens through special cards (currently - more ways to recharge coming up!)

You can now draw more than 2 cards at once (by default, your Max Draw is upgraded through Action Surges - Tenacity will start you with a 3rd card from the first upgrade, the others only from the second upgrade on). In the future, look out for cards and equipment that may further increase your Max Draw!
Some new cards, including a smaller bomb, "Grenade", for all your explodey needs.
An all-new character, Nela, with an all-new quest chain centered around the Lumberyard, featuring new locations, new monsters, and new mechanics.
A new objective system, allowing for more dynamic objectives (currently in use mainly for the new in-progress Dungeon Run systems).

notes.title: Version 1.2.5
notes.content:
Hail Willowguards!

A quick little v. 1.2.5 update to celebrate the new week:

[list]
[*] Each combat track now has a corresponding 'calm' version that plays when the level is clear (or at least appears clear...).
[*] Health bars can now be shown independently (e.g. only armor, only magic armor, only health), which may help estimate when you can actually start doing health damage to especially high-armored enemies.
[*] Items can now be unequipped! Yes, you can unequip your sword. No, there is no in-game effect. Sorry.
[*] Various adjustments to enemy attack signalling, such as an added glint effect, and all attacks (especially by Corpseflies, Snapjaws and Wormmouths) now having some form of warning beforehand. Also slightly adjusted timings on some of these attacks to make damage from them seem less random.
[*] Poison DOT damage no longer causes blood to spurt from you (neither does electricity damage).
[*] Certain damage types now makes the character flash a different color (e.g. green for poison).
[*] Damage-over-time effects now have a flashier VFX to let you know they've happened (applies to Poison, Bleed and Acid).
[*] Fixes to the effect location, so now e.g. the wormmouth's poison attack vfx actually comes from its mouth and not from wherever.
[*] Settings menu now applies changes properly.
[*] Some minor UI fixes regarding tooltips and snapping the virtual cursor to scrollbars.
[*] Other minor fixes here and there.
[/list]

We're definitely not done with Willow Guard, and are currently hard at work on some post-game content, new story content, new quests, new items, and new abilities!

notes.title: Hotfix version 1.2.4.2 - Too many VFX:es!
notes.content:
Here's another quick weekend hotfix, thank you again for your reports!

- There is now a definite limit to the number of VFX:s that can spawn, which should prevent some of the null reference exceptions some of you have been experiencing. [b]NB: In especially intense situations you may find that no more VFX:s are being spawned. You can adjust the max number with the new slider in Settings under Graphics - 25 has been proven to be plenty in most situations, but YMMV![/b]
- The end-game dungeon trap [spoiler]in the Temple[/spoiler] no longer spawns an endless number of [spoiler]golems[/spoiler], and it also handles it more elegantly if you leave and return without finishing the puzzle.
- The invisible walls in [spoiler]the first Temple level[/spoiler] are no longer invisible.

notes.title: Version 1.2.4
notes.content:
Hail Willowguards!

Version 1.2.4 is now out for your enjoyment. This patch contains two major updates, one of which has a bunch of cascading effects:

[list]
[*] We have optimized how VFX effects are instantiated and pooled, which has seen a significant increase in FPS in lower-end machines. If you've suffered from excessive stuttering before, this update may or may not help. Higher end machines are unlikely to see any visible changes in all but the most intense scenarios.
[*] Finishing Zarar's questine was unfortunately broken! This was due to a bug that placed Zarar in the Roadhouse when he was supposed to be [spoiler]in the Grove Vault Forge[/spoiler]. Now that his quest is fixed, make sure to have a chat with him after [spoiler]convincing Ajati to come fire up the forge[/spoiler].
[*] With the fixing of Zarar's questline you can now also gain access to [spoiler]the Forged Kaido[/spoiler] and its special card, [spoiler]the Void Bomb[/spoiler] as well as some other cascading effects. Have fun!
[*] It should now ACTUALLY be possible to 100% the game thanks to the above.
[*] There is now an Albino Wormmouth in the game, although it remains a somewhat elusive creature that you are unlikely to see until the very end. Watch out for its heavy armor and ability to regenerate not only its own, but its allies armor!
[/list]

Smaller fixes include:
[list]
[*] Spikes during the [spoiler]Woikos defence mission[/spoiler] are no longer invisible.
[*] Extra period removed from Bhorsos' Arrowroot-selling dialog.
[*] The mission Bhorsos gives you for clearing [spoiler]Sunspring Fields[/spoiler] is now more robust, and should handle various edge cases better.
[*] The "Hold down Esc to end the dungeon" prompt now minimizes to the right-hand side of the screen after 20 seconds.
[*] You can now ask Ajati to [spoiler]come to the Grove Vault Forge[/spoiler] even if she is at the Blacksmith, provided it is evening.
[*] Fixed a few unreachable spots that might spawn monsters, per reports from players.
[*] Various typos and minor bug fixes here and there.
[/list]

Everyone on the team has been taking a well-earned rest after the release, but now that some time has passed we're starting up work again properly! What's next, you ask? More monsters, more items, more characters, more cards, and perhaps - finally - the promised Dungeon Run mode...

PS: The Demo version has also been updated to 1.2.4 and the saves are, as always, compatible!

notes.title: Version 1.2.3.1
notes.content:
Hello Willowguards!

We're so happy with the reception of the game so far, and for all the wonderful comments and feedback we've gotten since launch. Thank you so much for all the love shown to our scrappy wee indie game. That said, as is the nature of any game, we've also discovered some bugs that we've now fixed (to the best of our knowledge). Changelog follows:

[list]
[*] The broken Steam Achievements should now function again, so 100% the game might finally be possible!
[*] A bug where you could not progress past the [spoiler]Equinox Celebration[/spoiler] near the end of the game has now been fixed!
[*] Story scene loading has been optimized: it should no longer take more than a few seconds to load from Dungeon -> Story.
[*] To help visualize when an attack is coming, melee and projectile aim cones now have animations to show progress!
[*] You can now actually finish the Whispering Glens dungeon even after [spoiler]meeting with the Goddess[/spoiler]
[*] Some updates to the attacks/patterns of certain bosses.
[*] The dungeon pause menu is now ultrawide compatible.
[*] New Outro music
[*] Better clean-up of certain clues.
[*] Monster codex entries should now update properly when you meet them the first time.
[*] A fix for a rare bug where if you die at the same moment as you draw a card the card draw screen remained open after continuing.
[*] The Heavy attack glint is now properly placed on the sword no matter your facing.
[*] A number of ghweros's abilities now use unscaled time when hyperfocusing (e.g. healing)
[*] A bunch of other minor bug fixes here and there.

[/list]

The update may be surprisingly big, mainly due to the changes in how the 4K story backgrounds are loaded, but this should be a one-time thing!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.content:
Hello Willowguards!

Will you look at that - it's almost time! Tomorrow by this time our fingers will be hovering over the green RELEASE APP button, but until then, you still have a chance to test out the demo and perfect your first day run (reminder: save files carry over automatically into the main game - no need to do anything on your part! It Just Works (TM)!)

Anyway, this penultimate pre-release update doesn't have anything paricularly dramatic in it, but hopefully we've finally squashed some very long-lasting bugs that have been popping up here and there in streams and the like, to our great consternation. To boot:

- The "virtual cursor suddenly appearing while playing with a controller" bug has, hopefully, been squashed.
- You can now actually see the amounts of material you are paying when crafting, not just what you are missing. Oops.
- The Settings menu should now be slightly less haunted and glitchy.
- Slight fixes to card selection to minimize certain edge-case bugginesses (that may have caused you to pick the wrong card accidentally).
- Armor Glue wasn't working properly. Now it is!
- The Verminfang (those of you who have managed to meet this one in the demo know) now has its attack indicator back.
- Some sound issues (a certain ominous hole made sounds even when the sound is muted)

Are you excited? I'm excited.

notes.title: Demo update: New theme!
notes.content:
Hello Willowguards!

The release draws ever nearer, and as it does, stuff and things begin to wrap up. One of those is our fantastic collaboration with Jussi Elsilä (Sound of Syndrome, also the composer of fellow Finnish studio title [i]Barotrauma[/i]!), who aside from having mixed and normalized all of our sounds, also made us a beautiful new Main Menu theme. I think it really gets stuck in your head, so this update is mainly to give you a chance to get infected with this earworm too!

Other changes include:
- the game now pauses if your controller gets unplugged/runs out of battery mid-battle
- hopefully some fixes to the audio slider twitchiness we'll seen in some streams (sorry Penny!)
- some new UI animations for scrapping and crafting
- a slightly updated dungeon pause menu (in anticipation for some bigger updates!)
- monsters should not longer stop chasing you if you stand on top of them
- a new card icon for Shadowstep, to make it clearer it is in fact an -upgrade- to your dodge

Wishlist that game! Tell everyone about it! Get your friends to wishlist! Let's go! We're still not on Popular Upcoming!

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.1 RC of demo released!
notes.content:
Hello Willowguards!

We're proud to have updated the version number of the demo (as well as the internal dev build, of course) to 1.0! Or, in this case, 1.0.0.1, addressing a few minor additions. Although work continues all the time, we're happy to say things are racing towards completion. Exciting!

Anyway, please enjoy the updated version of the game. The most obvious update (and why it's a bit heftier than usual) is an update to the AUDIO side:

- Remastered most of the combat music!
- Remixed and edited most sounds, both UI and dungeon SFX, for a more pleasant audio experience.
- Added sounds to the intro!
- Added a "mute when unfocused" button to Settings (on by default) that mutes all audio when the application is not the focus.

In addition to that of course there are also various bug fixes and other minor edits throughout the gam:

- FIxed an issue where scrolling right during investigations with the mouse didn't work very well.
- Updated various VFX bits and pieces as well as some animations.
- Fixed an issue with card draws becoming invisible.

Enjoy, and let us know if you find any new and exciting bugs with this release!

notes.title: Willow Guard Demo Updated - New Save System!
notes.content:
Hello again Willowguards!

We've just updated the demo to version 0.19.9.1, which brings with it multiple small but pretty additions, and one big and scary one. Let's start with some of the small and pretty additions before tackling the big scary one:
- Some new backgrounds replete with pretty parallaxing!
- A new fancy sheen to the blacksmith/card upgrade menus
- A bunch of bug fixes (such as cooldown timers now pausing properly when the game is paused)
- Various other little UI, UX and other such polishing.

And the big one: [b]the new save system![/b]

When loading a game, you will now be able to pick between up to 10 checkpoints (you can set how often they're saved in Settings). This means you'll now have some ability to go back to an earlier spot if you for some reason need to. For the most part, though, this update will be quite invisible to the user, and things will continue to work as before!

EXCEPT, of course, that it means all of your current saves will seem to have disappeared after the update - [b]but fear not, they can, in fact, be saved (pun intended).[/b]

Do this:
[list]
[*] Start the demo, despair for a moment that your saves are gone, and then start a new game in the slot you used.
[*] Quit the game, and then go to C:\Users\<your user name\AppData\LocalLow\MiTale Oy\Willow Guard
[*] Take your old save for the slot, named something like "slot_x.save" (where x is the number of the slot, starting from 0 for slot 1) and put it into the new folder for the slot, named "SaveSlot_X" (where X is the same number as your old save).
[*] Delete the new save inside the slot, named "slot_x_0.save" (where x is the slot number).
[*] Rename your old save to "slot_x_0.save" (again, x being the slot number, so e.g. "slot_0_0.save")
[*] Start up the game again, and when you press Continue, you should load up your old save, safe and sound.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531781/c69ca710471e445da9b6159fffdb0a865bb5f922.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update (and Demo removal)
notes.content:
Hello Willowguards!

Our scribes have been too busy in the dev mines to come up for air for some time, apologies for that. Hopefully you have all been enjoying the very extended Steam Next Fest demo, as we will now (finally) be taking that down! The reason being that it no longer entirely represents the current state of the game. But fear not - we'll be cooking up a new, more representative demo soon enough!

Thank you to everyone who played, commented, and wishlisted!

[h1]Puzzle Dungeons[/h1]

Currently, our dungeons have been entirely combat-focused, but that is something that is going to see a change soon. The new puzzle dungeons will contain traps, puzzles, lore, new enemies and new ways of using your Willowguard abilities to overcome them all. Powered by ancient magical machines that have continued to operate long after the gods have gone, these dungeons guard the secrets of the ancient world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531781/a2744ed630af0df45b1162e1b9d5a6f00b09d279.gif[/img]

These dungeons represent a huge shift in how you approach the moment-to-moment gameplay in Willow Guard, so be sure to stick around for more updates.

Thank you for now, and fair winds, Willowguards!

notes.title: Willow Guard Demo Updated to 0.8.4.1!
notes.content:
Hey all!

Thank you so much to everyone who played our demo to date, wishlisted the game, and interacted with us in any form - it's been quite the whirlwind!

First of all: in order to make sure as many of you who downloaded our demo but did not have time to play it during Next Fest has a chance to play it, we'll keep the demo up for a while longer - at least until the end of this week, possibly until the end of the month. We know the demo has quite a bit of content in it, which might take you a little while to finish :)

Want to keep it open longer? Give us feedback and bug reports either in the Community Forums or, even better, in our [url=https://discord.gg/EpW69MP]Discord[/url] where we can chat with you directly, so we know someone is still playing!

Secondly: [b]update 0.8.4.1 of the demo is now out![/b] It contains both bug fixes and some QOL fixes, so do make sure to download it if you can. Your saves should be unaffected. Here's a short changelog:

- A fix to the dreaded black screen of doom bug that was reported several times to us. Thanks to RedBlazin in our DIscord for sticking around and letting us find the solution!
- The slowdown when nearing an exit (in maps with exits) is now fixed.
- Potion of Celerity and Speed Rune now work as intended.
- Various map fixes to prevent spawning or getting stuck in impassable places.
- Interactables are now given a much more visible glow on approach.
- Visual fixes in dungeons, including fixes to treetops during nighttime levels, shadows, rendering order etc.
- Fixes to the UI to stop overflow of text.
- The crafting UI now displays Craft first and Upgrade second (as Crafting is much more common than Upgrading).
- Fixed a CTD when returning to camp after the Moonglades.

We have also for now disabled the rumble effect on controllers, as we suspect it may have caused the character to sometimes stop moving during gameplay.

Watch this space for future updates from the world of the Willowguards!
